'''XPLR-45.934.R.E.25-0003.245''' was an [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] [[docufile]]. It detailed the standard rewards offered for exploration and navigational coordinates of unexplored [[Planet/Legends|planets]].
